author: perrotta
body:
#### PR description:

The Run3 data GT in autoCond is updated with the payloads in the IOVs relevant for the planned 2023+2024 HI data reprocessing, as requested in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/17 , with the updates discussed in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/29

The new GT is [170X_dataRun3_v4](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/170X_dataRun3_v4) and the relevant differences are:
- [Diff wrt 170X_dataRun3_v2](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/170X_dataRun3_v4/170X_dataRun3_v2) (previous in autoCond)
- [DIff wrt 170X_dataRun3_HI_rereco_23_24_v2](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/170X_dataRun3_v4/170X_dataRun3_HI_rereco_23_24_v2) (the GT originally intended for the 2023+2024 HI rereco, which should be identical to 170X_dataRun3_v4 in the IOVs relevant for that re-reco)

Here are summarized the main differences or updates with respect to the previous GT in autocond:
- CSCChamberTimeCorrectionsRcd tag as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/4)
- Ecal/ES tags as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/5)
- SiStrip bad channels as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/6)
- Egamma regression and dedx calibration as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/7)
- SiPixelGain as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/11)
- Muon alignment as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/14)
- PF Calibration as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/15)
- HCAL related tags, as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/17) (updated in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/31))
- Centrality and Event Plane calibrations as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/28) (centrality table updated also for 2025 as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/2025-pbpb-centrality-calibration-integration-in-gt/148666/10) and for 2026 as in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gt-integration-for-2026-pbpb-centrality-calibration/150211/2) )

title: Update offline data GT in autoCond with the IOVs relevant for the 2023+2024 HI reprocessing
